# Load Packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(wesanderson)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)
library(p8105.datasets)
```

# Load Data:
```{r}
data("weather_df")
```

## Start with a scatterplot:
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, y = tmin, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Temp (Max vs Min)",
    x = "Max Temp (C)",
    y = "Min Temp (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from NOAA for three weather stations."
  ) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-10, 0, 15),
    labels = c("Negative Ten", "Zero", "Fifteen!!")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = "log",
    position = "right"
  )
```

## Plots with new colors!
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, y = tmin, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Temp (Max vs Min)",
    x = "Max Temp (C)",
    y = "Min Temp (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from NOAA for three weather stations."
  ) +
  viridis::scale_colour_viridis(
    name = "Location",
    discrete = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    transform = scales::transform_log(),
    position = "right"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Date vs Max Temp",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Max Temp (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from NOAA for three weather stations."
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette("Darjeeling1")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    transform = scales::transform_log(),
    position = "right"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Two more useful plot things:
```{r}
central_park_df = 
  weather_df |> 
  filter(name == "CentralPark_NY")

molokai_df  = 
  weather_df |> 
  filter(name == "Molokai_HI")

ggplot(molokai_df, aes(x = date, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(data = central_park_df) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette("Darjeeling1"))
```

## Multiple panels with different plot types:
```{r}
ggp_tmax_tmin <- 
  weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette("Darjeeling1"))

ggp_prcp_density <-
  weather_df |> 
  filter(prcp > 0) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = prcp, fill = name)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette("Darjeeling1")) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) 
  

ggp_seasonal <-
  weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = wes_palette("Darjeeling1"))

(ggp_tmax_tmin + ggp_prcp_density) / ggp_seasonal
```
